name: Giant Defy Advanced SL 1
why_interesting: Exact-trim public notes and a current official 2026 reference establish the higher-tier Defy Advanced SL 1 separately from the existing Defy Advanced 2 candidate.
missing: Map the public-post bikes to the referenced 2026 official generation and reconcile the seatpost descriptions
Confirm the community-reported 7.4 kg complete weight with official or measured evidence
Current mainland CNY price, stock, purchase route and warranty

facts.drivetrain: 2026 official reference: SRAM Force AXS E1 electronic 2×12, 46/33 and 10-36
facts.brakes: 2026 official reference: SRAM Force E1 hydraulic disc, 160 mm
facts.frame: 2026 official reference: Advanced SL-grade composite with integrated seatpost
facts.sizes: S, M, M/L and L on the referenced UK page

support_note: Giant provides an official mainland dealer locator and warranty policy; neither establishes current Defy Advanced SL 1 stock or price.
source_note: The official facts are a 2026 global-market reference and do not prove that every public-post bike is the same generation or establish mainland availability. A 2025-09-18 community ride note claims 7.4 kg complete weight, while another community comment says the current SL is not an integrated-seatpost model; both remain community reports pending generation mapping. The older source URL may be stale without a search token; 68cbb036 is a working exact-trim explore URL from the 2026-08-20 capture.
